value.value: THE SKY IS TEARING. Finish it.
Rumors ride the flare-wakes. Start with the greeter at Capitol OG.
Hear the prophecy at Mercurial, and ask the corn farmer on Iowan what the freighters saw.
Go BACK to Capitol OG — the greeter's script is fraying. Two proofs are enough.
Proof of the frozen sky: revisit Ursa Major's observatory, then offer Storm Corn at Etna Diadem. Outposts you've met have new things to say.
Proof in old money: go back to the Pour Lords, then feed their manifest to the relay at Caelus.
Proof from the verses: sit with the Patriarch at Mercurial again, then buy the Oldest Pattern from the Venusians.
Descend beneath Capitol OG. Bring the Abyssal Lantern from Europapas.
The Old Console at Capitol OG awaits your final output. The Regent's Signet may open one more door.
The run has ended. Thank you for playing.
